end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi counted one bundle as 1 instead of 10 when finding the total.
For 14, Saanvi identified 4 loose sticks but treated the bundle as 1.
The bundle-counting mix-up was still present at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised showing 11–20 as one group of ten and some loose ones. Saanvi used the loose sticks to identify the extra ones, but the bundle was still counted as 1 rather than 10, and this was not corrected before stopping. At home, make a bundle of 10 straws and place 1–9 loose straws beside it, then ask, “How many altogether?”
